response.justification: Bogdan brings relevant geospatial domain knowledge and demonstrated systems optimization experience from high-scale projects. However, his modern C++ skills are significantly outdated (last used 10+ years ago at National Instruments), with recent work focused on TypeScript/Node.js and AI infrastructure. While his technical breadth and problem-solving mindset are strong, he lacks recent systems programming experience and specific routing/navigation product expertise, creating substantial ramp-up risk for a primary C++ systems role.
strengths: Deep geospatial expertise with proven GISCollective open-source platform addressing real navigation and mapping challenges
Demonstrated ability to build and optimize high-performance systems handling millions of requests per second with low-latency requirements
Versatile engineer with willingness to expand expertise across technical stacks, comfortable learning new domains and technologies
concerns: Last significant C++ work was 10+ years ago (National Instruments 2014-2015); primary recent experience is TypeScript/Node.js, creating concern about current systems programming capability
No Rust experience despite it being acceptable alternative; recent career focused on web/AI rather than systems-level or compiled language development
Lacks specific routing and navigation guidance product experience; GIS data collection (GISCollective, Green Map) differs substantially from routing optimization and production navigation systems
